about: GlitchSAT on SYNFI's real OpenTitan netlists (lowRISC/synfi @ 2d08c4c, Yosys + Nangate45). All verdicts are for modelled faults; sequential results are bounded (N cycles).

e5_reconciliation.question: E5: GlitchSAT (SYNFI counting) 80 effective of 309,580 injected faults; paper 62 of 309,500

paper.where: SYNFI paper, Table 7 row 2 and Sec. 4.3 text: "only 62 (0.02%) out of 309,500 injected faults"

e5_reconciliation.counting_rule: SYNFI counts faults, not fault sets: fi_injector.handle_fault_model logs len(sets)*k and evaluate_fault_results adds 1 per fault location of every set; with k = 2 every number is twice the number of fault sets.

synfi_enumeration.how: --auto_fl: every target-graph node except in/out nodes and registers; one entry per (parent cell, graph node) as built by handle_fault_locations, so the nodes of a register that unroll_circuit cut into c input copies are listed c times each (register node included); itertools.combinations(entries, 2) x product of each entry's mapping list; no limit.
